beats.title: Find the stable
beats.description: A quest sends the player to a stable somewhere in the forest, or wherever the map actually put one.

beats.title: Take the horse tranquilizer
beats.description: No inventory exists yet, so the tranquilizer is modelled as a flag the stable sets rather than a carried item — see docs/BACKLOG.md item 15's stated dependency on item 11's story runtime, which is not built yet either.

lines.text: A tranquilizer, half-used, sits on the tack-room shelf.
